field.label: Log emails even if email communications is disabled
field.comment:
This setting only matters when Stores > Configuration > Advanced > System > Mail Sending Settings > Disable Email Communications is set to "Yes", i.e. when Magento does not send any emails.
Yes — emails are still written to the Emails Log with the "Not Sent" status, although they are not delivered to recipients. Useful on staging and QA environments, where outgoing mail must stay off but you need to see which emails the store would have sent.
Limitation: sales emails (order, invoice, shipment, credit memo and their comment emails) are not logged even when this setting is "Yes". While email communications are disabled, Magento skips these emails before they are composed, so there is nothing to log.
No — nothing is logged while email communications are disabled.
When "Disable Email Communications" is set to "No", this setting has no effect: emails are sent and logged as usual ("Success" or "Failed").
This setting never affects email delivery itself. It only controls what is written to the log.

field.label: Save Email Content
field.comment: Adds the ability to view additional information about letters.

field.label: Clear records older than (days)
field.comment: Records older than the specified number of days will be automatically cleared. If you set empty or zero records will not be deleted!
